final: WITH event_totals AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(spent) AS total_spent, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), ratios AS (SELECT event_id, total_spent / NULLIF(total_amount, 0) AS spend_ratio FROM event_totals), overall AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS avg_spend_ratio FROM ratios) SELECT r.event_id, r.spend_ratio, r.spend_ratio / o.avg_spend_ratio AS relative_spend_ratio FROM ratios AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY (r.spend_ratio / o.avg_spend_ratio) IS NULL ASC, relative_spend_ratio DESC LIMIT 10.
